2607.07996.title: SpO$_2$ Predictor-Guided Stage-Wise Time-Frequency Reconstruction of Low-Quality Dual-Wavelength PPG for Oxygen Saturation Estimation
2607.07996.paper_summary: Continuous oxygen saturation (SpO$_2$) estimation from wearable photoplethysmography (PPG) is important for long-term health monitoring, but low-quality red and infrared PPG segments can distort waveform morphology and degrade SpO$_2$ prediction accuracy. Existing PPG denoising and reconstruction methods usually optimize waveform fidelity or heart rate characteristics, while time-domain waveform loss on PPG signals alone insufficiently preserves frequency structure and SpO$_2$-relevant information. This paper proposes a SpO$_2$ predictor-guided stage-wise time-frequency reconstruction framework for low-quality dual-wavelength PPG signals. The proposed method first selects high-quality PPG segments to pretrain a SpO$_2$ predictor. A masked reconstruction model is then trained to recover randomly masked PPG regions using a joint reconstruction objective that combines time-domain waveform loss with frequency-domain loss computed from the short-time Fourier transform (STFT). To make the reconstruction task physiologically relevant, the pretrained SpO$_2$ predictor is incorporated as an additional constraint, encouraging the reconstructed PPG to preserve SpO$_2$ information rather than only minimizing waveform reconstruction error. The SpO$_2$ predictor and PPG reconstructor model are optimized through four training stages. Experiments on the public OpenOximetry Repository and a private wearable PPG dataset show that the proposed approach achieves the lowest subject-level MAE, with 2.882\% on the public dataset and 2.359\% on the private dataset.
2607.07996.paper_summary_zh: 持續的氧氣飽和度 (SpO$_2$) 從可穿戴光電容積描記法 (PPG) 的估算對於長期健康監測非常重要，但低品質的紅光和紅外PPG片段可能會扭曲波形形態並降低SpO$_2$預測的準確性。現有的PPG去噪和重建方法通常優化波形保真度或心率特徵，而僅針對PPG信號的時域波形損失不足以保留頻率結構和與SpO$_2$相關的信息。本文提出了一種基於SpO$_2$預測器指導的階段性時頻重建框架，用於低品質雙波長PPG信號。所提出的方法首先選擇高品質的PPG片段來預訓練SpO$_2$預測器。然後訓練一個遮罩重建模型，以使用結合時域波形損失和從短時傅里葉變換 (STFT) 計算的頻域損失的聯合重建目標來恢復隨機遮罩的PPG區域。為了使重建任務在生理上相關，預訓練的SpO$_2$預測器被納入作為額外約束，鼓勵重建的PPG保留SpO$_2$信息，而不僅僅是最小化波形重建誤差。SpO$_2$預測器和PPG重建模型通過四個訓練階段進行優化。在公共的OpenOximetry Repository和一個私有可穿戴PPG數據集上的實驗表明，所提出的方法在受試者層級的平均絕對誤差 (MAE) 最低，公共數據集為2.882\%，私有數據集為2.359\%。
